ops.description: Git 2.56 PROMISOR_ONLY prefix iteration can miss a physical promisor duplicate when MIDX selects its non-promisor copy. The reviewed two-condition iterator fix now ships as full-feature git-promisor 2.56.0_1, published from 6d63 and installed through Root-authorized distinct-name bottle adoption. Installed paired proof 62657104 and independent review b59b9588 show connectivity children 1 to 0 while genuine non-promisor validation remains; fresh CCX uses patched ordinary Git. Core keg, opt, config and old dependency keg remain. Global graph task b137 and physical host recovery stay separate; Root explicitly superseded the original diagnostic-only installation fence.
